title: Advantech AOM-2721 Gains Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Certification on Qualcomm QCS6490
dek: Advantech’s QCS6490-based AOM-2721 now carries Ubuntu 24.04 LTS certification, giving low-power Qualcomm edge-AI designs a more standardized Linux path.
summary: The hardware was already relevant; the new signal is software maturity. Ubuntu LTS certification can materially reduce BSP and maintenance risk for teams considering Qualcomm edge AI outside an Android-centric product.
whyItMatters: The 45 × 45 mm OSM module combines QCS6490 compute with a cited 12 TOPS AI capability in a compact embedded form factor.
Ubuntu LTS certification can reduce BSP and maintenance uncertainty for teams that prefer mainstream Linux over a bespoke embedded distribution.
Long-term security support, camera drivers, QAIRT/QNN tooling and carrier-board availability now become the practical design-in questions.

reporting.heading: Operating-system maturity can change a hardware decision
paragraphs: A compute module may look attractive on paper but become expensive if the product team must maintain a custom Linux stack. Advantech’s Ubuntu 24.04 LTS certification for AOM-2721 reduces that particular risk around Qualcomm’s QCS6490.
The module is positioned around a compact 45 × 45 mm OSM form factor and Advantech cites up to 12 TOPS of AI performance.

reporting.heading: Ubuntu broadens the developer pool
paragraphs: A mainstream LTS distribution can make package management, security maintenance and application development more familiar to teams that do not want to live inside a vendor-specific Yocto environment.
That does not eliminate Qualcomm-specific software. Camera support, AI acceleration and low-level device enablement still depend on BSP quality, QAIRT/QNN tooling and Advantech’s maintained drivers.

reporting.heading: The comparison with other QCS6490 modules becomes more interesting
paragraphs: AAEON and other module vendors also expose QCS6490 in standardized form factors. AOM-2721’s Ubuntu certification gives it a differentiator that can be weighed against carrier availability, temperature range, pricing, I/O and lifecycle.
For Canadian OEMs, those system-level differences will matter more than the shared SoC name.

flypigTake: AOM-2721 is a good example of software certification increasing hardware value. FlyPig would compare QCS6490 modules not only on form factor and TOPS, but on Linux maintenance, camera enablement and how quickly a team can reproduce the vendor’s supported stack.
sourceNote: FlyPig AI independently analyzes Advantech’s public certification announcement. Ubuntu certification does not remove the need to validate camera, AI runtime, carrier and project-specific software support.
